description: AWPBI 3D links your Power BI dataset directly to the individual components of a custom 3D model. By mapping data records to physical geometries via shared ID fields, you can build a functional digital twin to monitor assets, track project status, and analyze spatial data within your report. When combined with project schedules or time-series data, the visual enables 4D reporting. This allows you to visualize structural progress, logistical phasing, or asset condition changes over a defined timeline. The visual supports standard Power BI interactivity. Selecting an element on the 3D model cross-filters the surrounding charts and tables, while interacting with native slicers updates the state of the 3D model. *Unrestricted and free for report creation and testing in Power BI Desktop. Important Note: A paid license is required to publish, share, or view this visual in the Power BI Service. Unlicensed visuals will be blocked when viewed on the web. You may purchase an individual license directly from Microsoft. Please email info@awpbi.com to purchase an enterprise license or custom implementation.
